name: Dashboard brief
summary: Before anyone builds the dashboard, the requester gets one brief that settles the work: the decisions it serves, what is shown, each metric's definition, the filters, notes on every source and who refreshes it. The requester approves what is shown and the definitions.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of analytics and reporting work, and its own rules for prepared work: the requester's decisions and the owner's exports as the only authority, stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, every gap written as a question, no figures invented, and nothing built or changed until a person decides.
